请在对应目标里重新录入密钥，否则工具会拒绝使用它。: Re-enter the key for those targets or tools will refuse to use them.
先选一个类型登记连接与只读范围，三个客户端随后就能按名称调用它。: Choose a type, register the connection and read-only scope, then clients can call it by name.
调整搜索词或类型筛选后再试。: Adjust the search or type filter and try again.
不同系统的连接方式、授权范围和只读规则不同，先选类型再填连接。: Each system has different connection, scope, and read-only rules. Choose a type first.
小写字母、数字与连字符，创建后不可修改；模型调用时传这个名字。: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Cannot be changed later; clients pass this name.
停用后模型无法使用该目标，配置会保留。: When disabled, clients cannot use this target; configuration is kept.
只读闸门只会访问这里列出的范围；留空时按该类型的默认语义处理。: Read-only guards only access the listed scope; empty values use the type default.
密钥只保存密文，页面不会回显；留空表示沿用原值。: Secrets are stored encrypted and never rendered; leave blank to keep the current value.
这些上限同样作用在测试连接与后续工具调用上。: These limits also apply to connection tests and later tool calls.
服务对八个组件绝对只读；账号即使有写权限也不会被使用。: All eight components are strictly read-only; write-capable accounts are not used for writes.
只允许小写字母、数字与连字符，以字母或数字开头结尾，最长 64 个字符，全局唯一: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; start and end with a letter or digit; max 64 chars; globally unique.
新建时必填项不能为空；编辑时留空沿用、勾选清除或填新值替换，三者互斥。: On create, required secrets cannot be empty. On edit, leave blank to keep, check clear, or enter a new value.
保存后会加密落盘，审计与日志不记录密钥。: Saved secrets are encrypted at rest; audit and logs never contain them.
完整字段说明与只读规则见仓库: See the repository for full field and read-only rules:
删除会一并移除该目标的密钥与配置；模型将立即无法调用它，且无法恢复。: Deleting removes this target's secrets and configuration immediately and cannot be undone.
这会把该项恢复为代码默认值，并写入审计。: This restores this setting to its default and writes an audit entry.
这会把所有系统配置恢复为代码默认值，并写入审计。: This restores all settings to their defaults and writes an audit entry.
目标、密钥、安全边界不会受影响；只恢复本页的运行策略。: Targets, secrets, and security boundaries are unaffected; only runtime settings are reset.
保存本组会写入审计；切换分组前请先保存。: Saving this section writes an audit entry; save before switching sections.
这些规则是硬边界，不通过系统配置放宽。: These are hard boundaries and are not relaxed by settings.
只读白名单、危险命令、目标范围、密钥与 TLS 校验不受系统配置影响。: Read-only allowlists, dangerous commands, target scope, secrets, and TLS verification are not affected by settings.
本页只调整默认值和运行节奏，不改变“能查什么、能连哪里”。: This page only adjusts defaults and cadence; it does not change what can be queried or connected.
行数、字节、超时和并发只影响资源消耗，不绕过目标授权范围。: Row, byte, timeout, and concurrency limits only affect resource use and do not bypass target scope.
危险与高开销规则、目标级 CA/mTLS、密钥加密始终生效。: Dangerous/high-cost rules, target-level CA/mTLS, and secret encryption always apply.
由环境变量/启动参数控制，修改需要重启；这里只读展示。: Controlled by environment/startup parameters; changes need a restart. Read-only here.
这些值由环境变量/启动参数控制，修改后需要重启；密钥内容不展示。: Controlled by environment/startup parameters; changes need a restart. Secret values are not shown.
登记线上系统并授权只读范围，模型按名称调用排查工具。: Register online systems and grant read-only scope; clients call them by name.
按分组切换配置；每次保存只影响当前分组，生效时机写在字段旁。: Switch sections to edit settings; saving affects only the current section. Effects are shown beside fields.
只允许单条 SELECT / SHOW / DESCRIBE / EXPLAIN: Only a single SELECT / SHOW / DESCRIBE / EXPLAIN is allowed; the session is forced read-only.
选择认证方式；无认证实例选 none。find 必须带过滤条件，聚合只允许读阶段: Choose an auth mode; use none for unauthenticated instances. find requires a filter; aggregations are read-only and $group/$lookup need a preceding $match.
只发 GET / HEAD 与 _search / _count 的 POST；: GET/HEAD only, plus POST to _search/_count; scripts and deep pagination are rejected.
命令白名单；支持 ACL 用户名、TLS CA 与客户端证书；无界范围与全键命令: Command allowlist; supports ACL usernames, TLS CA, and client certificates. Unbounded ranges and all-key commands are rejected.
只发 GET；Token 权限再大也不会写。: GET only; a write-capable token is still never used for writes.
只走 Management API 的 GET，不取消息。: Management API GET only; messages are not consumed.
只做描述类接口与保留范围内的有限拉取，不加入消费组；SASL 字段必须完整。: Describe APIs and bounded fetches within retention; no consumer group; SASL fields must be complete.
搜索必须带时间窗，单次不超过 24 小时。: Search requires a time window of at most 24 hours.
允许的库（一行一个，空=只允许默认库）: Allowed databases (one per line; empty = default only)
CA 证书 PEM（可选，私有 CA 时填写）: CA certificate PEM (optional; for private CAs)
连接 URI（auth_mode=uri 时必填，含凭证）: Connection URI (required for auth_mode=uri; contains credentials)
允许的日志主题（一行一个，日志集/topic）: Allowed log topics (one per line; logset/topic)
粘贴 PEM 证书；配置后必须启用 SSL。: Paste the PEM certificate; SSL must be enabled when set.
默认关闭；开启后 PROCESSLIST 可看到实例内其他库/用户的会话与 SQ: Disabled by default; when enabled, PROCESSLIST exposes sessions and SQL from other databases/users.
mTLS 客户端证书，与私钥必须同时提供；不加密的私钥。: mTLS client certificate; must be provided with the private key. The key must be unencrypted.
mTLS 客户端私钥，与证书必须同时提供；当前不支持带口令私钥。: mTLS client private key; must be provided with the certificate. Encrypted keys are not supported.
none = no auth; password = username/password; uri = full connection string (SRV/X.509/TLS and other advanced options).
配置后必须启用 TLS。: TLS must be enabled when set.
完整 mongodb:// 或 mongodb+srv:// URI；含凭证，加: Full mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// URI; credentials are encrypted.
粘贴 PEM 证书；配置后必须保持 TLS 校验开启。: Paste the PEM certificate; TLS verification must stay enabled when set.
新建目标表单的默认 timeout_s；既有目标仍使用各自配置。: Default timeout_s for new targets; existing targets keep their own value.
新建目标表单的默认 max_rows；既有目标仍使用各自配置。: Default max_rows for new targets; existing targets keep their own value.
新建目标表单的默认 max_bytes；既有目标仍使用各自配置。: Default max_bytes for new targets; existing targets keep their own value.
同一个目标同时进行的工具调用上限，超出会排队。: Max concurrent tool calls per target; excess calls queue.
超过该天数的审计记录会被定时清理；清理只记日志。: Audit entries older than this are cleaned periodically; cleanup only logs.
进程内缓存的连接器客户端数量；修改后在下一次取客户端时按新上限淘汰。: Max cached connector clients; the new limit applies on the next client lookup.
每轮清理后按该间隔休眠；修改后下一轮开始使用新值。: Sleep this interval after each cleanup; the new value applies next cycle.
只影响新建目标表单；既有目标保留各自已保存的 timeout / 行数 / 字节: Affects new target forms only; existing targets keep their saved timeout/rows/bytes.
并发上限立即生效；审计留存与清理间隔在下一轮清理周期生效。: Concurrency applies immediately; audit retention and cleanup interval apply next cycle.
影响进程内缓存与资源占用；修改后下一次工具调用生效，不需要重启。: Affects in-process cache and resource use; applies on the next tool call without restart.
失败原因已记录在目标行，可展开查看。: The error is recorded on the target row and can be expanded.
目标不存在或已被删除: Target not found or already deleted
配置连接、密钥与只读范围。: Configure the connection, secrets, and read-only scope.
配置 CA 证书时必须启用 TLS: TLS must be enabled when a CA certificate is configured
配置 CA 证书时 security_protocol 必须是 SSL 或 SA: security_protocol must be SSL or SASL_SSL when a CA certificate is configured
配置 CA 证书时必须启用 SSL: SSL must be enabled when a CA certificate is configured
配置 CA 证书时必须保持 TLS 校验开启: TLS verification must stay enabled when a CA certificate is configured
Elasticsearch 需要「用户名 + 密码」或 API Key，二选一: Elasticsearch requires either username + password or an API key
客户端证书与私钥必须同时提供或同时清除: Client certificate and private key must be provided or cleared together
配置 ACL 用户名时必须填写密码: A password is required when an ACL username is configured
auth_mode=none 时不能填写 URI、用户或密码: auth_mode=none does not allow URI, user, or password
无认证模式需要填写主机: Host is required in no-auth mode
CA 证书不是合法 PEM: CA certificate is not valid PEM
SASL 机制必须是 PLAIN / SCRAM-SHA-256 / SCRAM: SASL mechanism must be PLAIN / SCRAM-SHA-256 / SCRAM-SHA-512
SASL 协议需要填写 SASL 用户: SASL user is required for SASL protocols
SASL 协议需要填写 SASL 密码: SASL password is required for SASL protocols
非 SASL 协议不应填写 SASL 机制: SASL mechanism is not allowed for non-SASL protocols
非 SASL 协议不应填写 SASL 用户或密码: SASL user/password are not allowed for non-SASL protocols
默认时间窗不能大于最大时间窗: Default window cannot exceed max window
auth_mode=password 时不能填写连接 URI: auth_mode=password does not allow a connection URI
密码模式需要填写主机: Host is required in password mode
密码模式需要填写用户: User is required in password mode
密码模式需要填写密码: Password is required in password mode
URI 模式需要填写连接 URI: A connection URI is required in URI mode
auth_mode=uri 时 host、用户、密码必须留空: auth_mode=uri requires host, user, and password to be empty
仅 SQLite 且存在 pending migration 时生效；新迁移前保: Only applies to SQLite when a pending migration exists; keep the latest N backups before a new migration.
影响进程内缓存与 SQLite 备份保留；修改后下一次工具调用或下一次启动迁移生: Affects in-process cache and SQLite backup retention; applies on the next tool call or next startup migration.
